lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest concentration of large-diameter blobs located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal tiers of blobs, creating a non-uniform grid-like anchor system across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, marked by sharp pixel intensity gradients exhibiting high luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of small, uniform, high-luminance punctate spots that differ significantly in size and spacing from the larger blobs on the primary lateral flank.
